explainer.intro: Four signals, weighted and added. Each is normalised inside the window you picked, so the ranking always tells you the place to be during that window. Takeoffs are grouped into ~250 km² H3 regions so mountains with many launches aren't penalised.
explainer.consistencyDesc: % of flyable days the region produced a flight.
explainer.activityDesc: Number of flights in the region.
explainer.communityDesc: Unique pilots, guarding against one-pilot anomalies.
explainer.minimumSample: Minimum sample: {flights, plural, one {# flight} other {# flights}} · {pilots, plural, one {# pilot} other {# pilots}}. Below that, a region lives in the quiet drawer.
